product_metadata.title: Crabtree Collection Yellow Kitchen Towels Decorative Set of 2 Yellow Dandelion Floral Dish Towels Cotton Fabric Tea Towels for Kitchen Hand Towels Perfect for Cleaning and Drying
features: Upgrade your kitchen with our set of floral dish towels, perfect for wiping up spills, drying dishes, and adding a pop of color to your kitchen decor.
Our decorative dish towels feature charming farmhouse designs and vintage floral prints that will complement any kitchen style.
Our high-quality kitchen hand towels are made from soft, thickly-woven, absorbent, all-natural 100% cotton, no chemical smells.
A foodie dish towel is a must-have for any home chef; our kitchen tea towels come in a variety of fun designs and make great gifts.
Add charm to your vintage floral kitchen with our farmhouse dish towels. We also have a range of coordinating cloth napkins, table runners, and valances to complete your look.
